## Experiment

`solo` with `gemini-3.8-flash` at `high` thinking, 250 steps, compaction at 64K, and the per-turn step counter. Without the counter, this budget scored 7/10, and the 3 failing agents were stopped at step 250 with nothing pushed. This run tests whether the counter also helps when the budget is larger.

## Observations

- 9/10, the best `solo` result so far, at slightly lower cost than without the counter (`$17.05` vs. `$19.63`).
- Every agent pushed work and none was stopped at the step limit (without the counter, 3 were stopped with nothing pushed). Agents used 180 steps on average and compacted their context 7 times each.
- `dspy_task/8394` and `pallets_jinja_task/1559`, which failed without the counter, now pass. Only `pillow_task/290` failed: both features were submitted, but feature 4 failed its tests, as in every other run that got that far.
- 22 calls were retried because of the API rate limit, which only slows `solo` agents down.
